rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿００９Hey!￥Came by to hang out.＝＠２０６＿０１０So, you've been doing great￥lately. Did something happen?
Nope, same as always...
That's pure skill!
Nope, same as always.
That's pure skill!
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１１Really? So doing the same old￥thing, you still beat me at￥my specialty.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１２That's kind of embarrassing.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１３You must've had the talent all￥along. I'm jealous.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１４That's some confidence!￥When you put it like that,￥I can't really argue.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１５With that kind of drive, no￥wonder you beat me at my￥specialty.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１６If some jerk passed me I'd be￥mad, but losing to you doesn't￥feel so bad.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１７You're amazing.￥Strength was never your strong￥suit to begin with, right?
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１８You must've thrown yourself￥into training way harder￥than I did.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０１９Coach me sometime! With how￥you're doing now, I bet I'd￥improve faster. Don't you think?
Leave it to me!
I couldn't do that.
Sure, leave it to me!
I couldn't do that.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２０All right!￥I'm in your hands, Coach!
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２１Yeah, and honestly, you seem￥like you'd be a good teacher.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２２Oh, come on, don't be modest!＝＠２０６＿０２３At least you look like you'd be￥a better teacher than me.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２４And even if you're bad at it,￥I'd kind of like to see you￥get all flustered~
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２５Maybe I'll follow your example￥and put a little more effort￥into training.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２６If I let you keep pulling ahead,￥that'd be pretty pathetic for￥an expert like me.
＊Yoh＊＠２０６＿０２７Next time, coach me in more￥than just Strength training.＝＠２０６＿０２８Well, sorry for barging in￥on your day off.
